description: Chúng mình gồm Khoa và Tiến. Chúng mình năng động, nhiệt tình, có tinh thần học hỏi và khả năng làm việc nhóm. Nhóm mong muốn tìm kiếm những thành viên có trách nhiệm, sáng tạo, biết hợp tác và sẵn sàng chia sẻ ý tưởng để cùng nhau hoàn thành tốt mục tiêu chung.
summary: Our project offers a comprehensive perspective on the fate of abandoned satellites and space debris. By adopting the persona of the Opportunity rover, we recreate its arduous and resilient journey to deeply resonate with the audience. Building upon this, the project proposes practical solutions such as repurposing relay stations, cleaning up orbital debris, executing safe end-of-life maneuvers, and transforming retired machines into "historical monuments" registered within the NSSDCA. This initiative not only mitigates escalating space pollution but also honors scientific legacy, affirming that these one-way missions, though ending, remain eternal in humanity's history of space exploration.
details: Our project offers a comprehensive and deeply moving perspective on the fate of space hardware by adopting the persona of the Opportunity rover to recount its proud, one-way journey. To bring this to life, we utilized Gemini as an essential tool to research and synthesize scientific information, cross-reference verified data from NASA's NSSDCA database, and refine our phrasing. Through careful consideration of technical accuracy, practical feasibility, and audience emotional resonance, the project proposes actionable solutions such as orbital debris cleanup and establishing outdoor museums for historical spacecraft. Ultimately, it delivers a profound impact by raising public awareness and promoting sustainable space stewardship to honor humanity's cosmic heritage forever.
